articles.description: While iOS 27.2 beta 4 brought a new look for Apple Music and a reference to a new HomePod setting, it also curiously removed an upcoming Apple Health upgrade. Here's what you need to know. Apple's redesigned Health app is missing from the fourth beta of iOS 27.2. On Tuesday, shortly after unveiling its HomeView and other smart home products, Apple deployed the fourth developer beta of iOS 27.2. The beta software update bears the build number 24B5110a, up from 24B5099f. In a particularly noticeable visual change, iOS 27.2 beta 4 removes all color from the Apple Music icon. Now, it's just a black musical note on a white background, or inverted in dark mode, rather than the white and red look the icon has used since iOS 14.
